item.title: Bae Hyunjin Faces Another Ethics Committee Complaint… Day After Jang Dong-hyuk's 'Party Violation' Warning (배현진, 또 윤리위 제소…장동혁 ‘해당 행위’ 경고 다음날)
item.description:
Bae Hyunjin, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, has been reported to the party's ethics committee for publicly criticizing party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. This comes just one day after Jang warned of "strong measures against party violations." (배현진 국민의힘 의원이 장동혁 대표를 공개 비판했다는 이유로 당 윤리위원회에 제소됐다. 장 대표가 “해당 행위를 강력 조치하겠다”고 경고한 지 하루 만이다.)

According to a disciplinary request obtained by The Hankyoreh on the 24th, some candidates for Seoul metropolitan and district council seats from the People Power Party claimed that "the respondent (Rep. Bae), who serves as the chair of the Seoul party chapter, has not stopped criticizing and mocking the party leadership, including Representative Jang, during this critical time ahead of the local elections." (한겨레가 24일 입수한 징계 요청서를 보면, 국민의힘 서울 광역·기초의원 출마자 일부는 “서울시당위원장인 피청구인(배 의원)은 지방선거를 앞두고 있는 엄중한 시기에 장 대표를 비롯한 당 지도부를 향해 비난과 조롱을 멈추지 않고 있다”고 주장했다.)

They pointed to messages Bae posted on Facebook, including "Jang Dong-hyuk, living so difficultly" (March 12), "Even if Jesus came, the metropolitan area wouldn't be winnable" (March 25), and "The worst party violation is Jang representative's every choice" (April 23), arguing that she "has abandoned her role as the Seoul party chapter chair, who should contribute to victory in the local elections, causing confusion among party members." They stated that Bae violated Article 6 (Rights and Duties of Party Members), Article 8, Paragraph 3 (Principle of Rejecting Factions) of the party constitution, and Article 4 (Maintaining Dignity) of the ethics rules. <<> Earlier, during the party's Supreme Council meeting the previous day, Representative Jang said, "An army with broken discipline can never win in battle," and "Now is the time to properly identify the enemy we must fight." <<> Bae had also been reported to the party's ethics committee in January. <<> At that time, the party's ethics committee decided on a severe disciplinary measure of a one-year suspension of party rights after Bae posted on Facebook a photo of a minor who had left critical comments, which was deemed a violation of children's rights and defamation. However, in March, Bae's injunction request against the People Power Party was accepted by the Seoul Southern District Court, putting the disciplinary action on hold. <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (이들은 배 의원이 페이스북에 쓴 “참 어렵게 산다 장동혁”(3월12일) “수도권은 예수님이 나와도 안 될 판”(3월25일) “최악의 해당행위는 장 대표의 모든 선택”(4월23일) 등의 메시지를 문제 삼으며 “지방선거 승리에 기여해야 하는 서울시당위원장으로서의 역할을 저버리며 당원들에게 혼란을 야기”했다고 주장했다. 이들은 배 의원이 당헌 제6조(당원의 권리와 의무), 8조3항(계파불용 원칙), 윤리규칙 4조(품위유지) 등을 위반했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Korean man kidnapped in Malaysia rescued, all three Korean suspects arrested (말레이시아서 납치된 한국인 남성 구조, 한국인 납치범 3명도 모두 검거)
item.description:
A Korean man who was kidnapped in Malaysia has been rescued by local authorities. (말레이시아에서 납치됐던 한국인 남성이 현지 당국에 의해 구조됐다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 24th, a Korean man in his 40s residing in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, was kidnapped on the 17th and rescued by Malaysian local authorities on the 21st. The three kidnappers were also apprehended, and they have all been identified as Korean nationals. ( 24일 외교부에 따르면 말레이시아 쿠알라룸푸르에 거주하던 40대 한국인 남성 1명이 지난 17일 납치됐다가 21일 말레이시아 현지 당국에 의해 구조됐다. 납치범 3명도 함께 검거됐는데 모두 한국인으로 파악됐다. )

This is the first time a kidnapping involving a Korean national has occurred in Malaysia, where public security is relatively stable. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs received a kidnapping report via the Consular Emergency Call Center on the 19th, activated the Overseas Nationals Protection Task Force, and held situation review meetings between headquarters and overseas missions to respond. The Embassy in Malaysia also set up an on-site command center and cooperated with local authorities to support the rescue. ( 치안이 비교적 안정된 말레이시아에서 한국인 납치 사건이 일어난 것은 이번이 처음이다. 외교부는 지난 19일 영사안전콜센터를 통해 납치 신고를 접수한 뒤 재외국민대책본부를 가동하고 본부-공관 상황점검회의를 개최하는 등 대응에 나섰다. 주말레이시아대사관도 현장 지휘 본부를 설치하고 현지 당국과 협조해 구조를 지원했다.)

item.title: Hong Joon-pyo: "Bluff batters, chicken-hearted pitchers... Samsung has so much money, giving them tens of billions" (홍준표 “공갈포 타자, 새가슴 투수…삼성 돈 많다, 저런 데 몇십억씩 주고”)
item.description:
Former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo has criticized the professional baseball team Samsung Lions, saying, "Samsung must really have a lot of money to give tens of billions in annual salaries to players like these." (홍준표 전 대구시장이 프로야구 삼성라이온즈에 대해 “저런 선수들에게 몇십 억씩 연봉 안겨주는 삼성은 참 돈이 많은가 보다”고 지적했다.)

In a Facebook post on the previous day, the 24th, the former mayor mentioned the real names of some Samsung Lions players, stating, "Aside from (those players), I don't see any Samsung players who are worth their salaries." (홍 전 시장은 전날인 24일 페이스북에 글을 올려 일부 삼성라이온즈 소속 선수들의 실명을 언급하며 “(해당 선수들) 이외에는 연봉값 하는 삼성 선수들이 보이지 않는다”며 이같이 말했다.)

He criticized, "It's disheartening to see bluff batters who aren't home run hitters but keep striking out, and 'chicken-hearted' pitchers who can't throw a single proper strike and just produce walks," adding, "There are batters batting in the .100s who can't even hit the ball properly because their lower bodies are shaky and their hips are weak." (그는 “홈런 타자가 아닌데도 매일 삼진이나 당하는 공갈포 선수, 스트라이크 하나 제대로 던지지 못해 포볼이나 양산하는 ‘새가슴’ 투수들 보니 한숨만 난다”며 “하체가 흔들리고 허리가 빠져 공도 제대로 못 맞히는 1할대 타자들”이라고 비판했다.)

He then said, "Since becoming unemployed, I've been living for the fun of watching baseball every day," and mentioned the return timeline of injured player Kim Sung-yoon. (그러면서 “백수된 후로 매일 야구 보는 재미로 사는데”라며 부상을 당했던 김성윤 선수의 복귀 시점을 언급하기도 했다.)

As of the time Hong posted on Facebook, the Samsung Lions had lost to the SSG Landers the previous day, suffering a four-game losing streak. They also lost to Kiwoom in the next game on the 24th, currently falling into a five-game losing streak. (삼성라이온즈는 홍 전 시장이 페이스북을 올린 시점 기준으로 전날 에스에스지(SSG) 랜더스에게 패배해 4연패를 당한 상태였다. 그 다음 경기인 24일 경기에서도 키움에 패배하며 현재는 5연패의 늪에 빠졌다.)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook Withdraws from Daegu Mayoral Election: "The Heart of Conservatism Cannot Fall to the Left" (이진숙, 대구시장 선거 출마 포기…“보수의 심장, 좌파에 넘어가면 안돼”)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook, former chairwoman of the Korea Communications Commission, who initially declared her candidacy for the Daegu mayoral election in the June 3 local elections under the People Power Party but was excluded from the nomination (cut off), has announced she will forgo running as an independent. (6·3 지방선거 대구시장 국민의힘 후보 경선에 출사표를 던졌으나 공천 배제(컷오프)됐던 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장이 무소속 출마를 포기하겠다고 밝혔다.)

In a statement released on the 25th, the former chairwoman explained, "I wanted to correct the unfair nomination exclusion through the power of the citizens, but concerns that Daegu might fall to the left blocked my decision to go as an independent." (이 전 위원장은 25일 입장문을 내어 “부당한 공천 배제를 시민의 힘으로 바로잡고 싶었으나, 대구까지 좌파에 넘어갈 수 있다는 우려가 무소속으로 가는 선택을 가로막았다”고 설명했다.)

In her statement, she emphasized, "On March 22, the Lee Jeong-hyun Nomination Committee cut me off without any convincing explanation. For 35 days after that, I requested that this unfair, unjust, and inequitable cut-off be overturned, but it was not accepted. Such an unfair cut-off must never happen again." (그는 입장문에서 “지난 3월 22일 이정현 공관위원회는 어떤 납득할 만한 설명 없이 저를 컷오프시켰다. 이후 35일 동안 부당하고 불공정하고 부정의한 컷오프를 복원시켜달라고 요청했으나 받아들여지지 않았다”며 “다시는 이런 불공정한 컷오프가 있어선 안 된다”고 강조했다.)

She added, "I had considered quitting the party and running as an independent to seek the judgment and choice of the citizens, and I was confident I could win. However, the worry that the red heart of conservatism could turn blue, and that the last bastion of liberal democracy could be seized by socialist populism, held me back." (이어 “탈당하여 무소속으로 출마해서 시민들의 판단과 선택을 받겠다는 마음도 있었고 승리할 수 있다는 자신도 있었다”면서도 “보수의 붉은 심장이 파란색으로 물들고 자유민주주의 최후의 보루가 사회주의 포퓰리즘에 장악된다면 대한민국은 어떻게 될 것인가 하는 우려가 발목을 잡았다”고 덧붙였다.)

The former chairwoman declared her withdrawal from the race, saying, "So today, I, Lee Jin-sook, step down from the position of preliminary candidate for Daegu mayor. And tomorrow, once the People Power Party's candidate for Daegu mayor is selected, I will lend my strength to ensure that person defeats the Democratic Party candidate." (이 전 위원장은 “그래서 오늘 저 이진숙은 대구시장 예비후보라는 자리를 내려놓는다”며 “그리고 내일 국민의힘 대구시장 후보가 선출되면, 그분이 민주당 후보를 이길 수 있도록 힘을 보탤 것”이라고 불출마를 선언했다.)

Currently, lawmakers Choo Kyung-ho and Yoo Young-ha are competing as preliminary candidates for the People Power Party's Daegu mayoral nomination. The People Power Party plans to decide on its final Daegu mayoral candidate to compete against Kim Boo-kyum of the Democratic Party of Korea on the 26th. (현재 국민의힘 대구시장 예비후보로는 추경호·유영하 의원이 맞붙고 있다. 국민의힘은 오는 26일 두 후보 가운데 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보와 경쟁할 최종 대구시장 후보를 결정할 예정이다.)

item.title: 'Jang Dong-hyuk, Deputy Secretary Meeting' Lie Controversy: People Power Party "Apologize for Misinformation" (‘장동혁, 차관보 면담’ 거짓말 논란에 국힘 “잘못 알려드린 부분 사과”)
item.description:
Amidst ongoing allegations that Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party (PPP), lied about meeting with a U.S. State Department deputy secretary, the PPP apologized on the 25th. <<> Park Sung-hoon, senior spokesperson for the PPP, told reporters at the National Assembly on that day, "If there were any misunderstandings or parts that were incorrectly reported concerning the information released at the time of departure, I think that is clearly wrong." He added, "The actions of the leader of the primary opposition party must carry seriousness and gravity. If there were administrative errors in the process of supporting this, we have no intention of avoiding responsibility." Spokesperson Park further stated, "If there are any parts that may cause misunderstandings, we offer our apologies and will work harder to win the hearts of our party members." <<> Earlier, in relation to his 10-day, 8-night visit to the United States, Representative Jang released a photo of the back of a U.S. State Department official and announced that he had met with a deputy secretary whose name could not be disclosed. However, a State Department spokesperson confirmed to The Hankyoreh that the person Jang met was Gavin Wax, Chief of Staff to the Deputy Assistant Secretary for Public Diplomacy. While the Chief of Staff to an Assistant Secretary is an official at the deputy secretary level, their role differs from that of a deputy secretary who is confirmed by the Senate and exercises independent policy authority. <<> The previous day, Representative Jang held a press conference and explained, "If I precisely reveal the title, it will identify who the person is, so I noted it as 'deputy secretary-level,' but it seems there was an operational oversight." Additionally, Jang claimed he met one more 'deputy secretary-level' individual, but JTBC reported that this person was not of deputy secretary level but a 'senior deputy assistant secretary.' In response to this report, the PPP stated that the person Jang met "attended the meeting with the acting title of deputy secretary, so we expressed it as deputy secretary-level." <<> Regarding Representative Jang's 'lie controversy,' criticism has also emerged from within the party. PPP lawmaker Jo Eun-hee criticized on Facebook, "The owner of the back-view photo that was carefully hidden for security reasons turns out to be a 30-something chief of staff to an assistant secretary? It's absurd and embarrassing to the people." She added, "Just don't say anything at all." <<> Meanwhile, ahead of the June 3 local elections, with the PPP's approval rating hitting a historic low of 15%, pressure is mounting from both inside and outside the party for Representative Jang to resign. Representative Jang has dismissed calls for his resignation, stating that he will accept judgment based on the election results. <<> Reporter Son Go-woon songon11@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 미 국무부 차관보를 만난 것처럼 거짓말을 했다는 의혹이 잇따르자 국민의힘이 25일 사과했다.)

item.title: With Lee Jin-sook’s withdrawal from Daegu mayoral race, Choo Kyung-ho and Yoo Young-ha, facing a runoff, express "respect for her decision" (이진숙 대구시장 불출마에 ‘결선 진출전’ 앞둔 추경호·유영하 “결단에 경의”)
item.description:
As former Broadcasting and Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook declared she would not run for the Daegu mayoralty in the June 3 local elections, candidates in the People Power Party primary, lawmakers Choo Kyung-ho and Yoo Young-ha, voiced their welcome, stating, "We express deep respect for her decision." (이진숙 전 방송통신위원장이 6·3 지방선거에서 대구시장 불출마를 선언하자 대구시장 국민의힘 경선 후보들인 추경호·유영하 의원이 “결단에 깊은 경의를 표한다”며 입을 모아 환영의 뜻을 밝혔다.)

On the 25th, Rep. Choo posted on Facebook, saying, "With Chairperson Lee’s decision, Daegu has finally become united. I too was moved by the sincere concern over what would happen to the Republic of Korea if Daegu were to fall to the left," and appealed, "Please join me in protecting Daegu from the reckless Democratic Party regime." (추 의원은 25일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이 위원장의 결단으로 대구는 마침내 하나가 됐다. 대구까지 좌파에 넘어가면 대한민국이 어떻게 될 것이냐는 진심 어린 걱정에 저 역시 울컥했다”며 “대구를 무도한 민주당 정권으로부터 함께 지켜내달라”고 당부했다.)

He further emphasized, "Chairperson Lee is a symbolic figure who has stood against the arrogant power of the Democratic Party regime," adding, "I will take even more seriously her decision to choose the path of walking together for the future of Daegu and the Republic of Korea over her personal path." (이어 “이 위원장은 민주당 정권의 오만한 권력에 맞서온 상징적 인물”이라며 “개인의 길보다 대구와 대한민국의 미래를 위해 함께 걷는 길을 선택해주신 그 뜻을 더욱 무겁게 받아들이겠다”고 강조했다.)

Rep. Yoo also stated through a press release, "I respect Chairperson Lee’s decision. It is a weighty decision that goes beyond individual political choices and considers the future of the party and Daegu together," adding, "Now we must set aside the time of conflict and competition and unite our strength as one." (유 의원 또한 보도자료를 통해 “이 위원장의 결단을 존중한다. 개인의 정치적 선택을 넘어, 당과 대구의 미래를 함께 고민한 무거운 결단”이라며 “이제 우리는 갈등과 경쟁의 시간을 뒤로 하고 하나로 힘을 모아야 할 때”라고 했다.)

He continued, "We will move beyond conflict and toward integration. With a united force, not division, we will surely achieve victory." (이어 “갈등을 넘어 통합으로 나아가겠다. 분열이 아닌 하나 된 힘으로 반드시 승리하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

The People Power Party plans to select one candidate between Rep. Choo and Rep. Yoo on the 26th as the party’s candidate for the Daegu mayoral election. The confirmed candidate will then face Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate for Daegu mayor. (국민의힘은 오는 26일 추 의원과 유 의원 가운데 1명을 지방선거 대구시장 후보로 선출할 예정이다. 확정된 후보는 김부겸 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보와 맞붙게 된다. )

item.title: President Lee says "What's the fun in living well alone?" ... "Severe punishment" for syringe hoarding (이 대통령 “혼자 잘 살면 뭔 재미?”…주사기 매점매석에 “엄중 단죄”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung shared an article on X (formerly Twitter) on the 25th about "massive crackdown on syringe hoarding," stating, "Such antisocial behavior that exploits the community's crisis to worsen it for profit will be severely punished." (이재명 대통령이 25일 엑스(X)에 ‘주사기 매점매석 무더기 적발’ 기사를 공유하며 “공동체의 위기를 이용해 위기를 악화시키며 돈벌이하는 이런 반사회적 행태는 엄중하게 단죄할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety conducted a special crackdown on syringe distributors nationwide from the 20th to the 22nd. As a result, companies were found that had been storing over 130,000 syringes without selling them for more than five days, and another that sold 620,000 syringes—59 times its average monthly sales—to 33 buyers over six days. A total of 32 companies violated the ban on syringe hoarding. (식품의약품안전처는 지난 20일∼22일 전국 주사기 판매업체를 특별 단속했다. 그 결과 5일 넘게 주사기 13만여개를 팔지 않고 보관하고 있었던 업체, 6일 동안 33개 구매처에 월평균 판매량의 59배를 초과하는 62만여개의 주사기를 판매한 업체 등이 드러났다. 주사기 매점매석금지 고시를 위반한 업체는 32곳에 달했다.)

President Lee wrote, "I have instructed the cabinet to conduct continuous crackdowns, as well as prompt investigations, severe punishments, and maximum administrative sanctions for any violations discovered. What's the fun in living well alone? Let's live together." (이 대통령은 “지속적 단속은 물론, 발각된 위반행위에 대해서는 신속한 수사와 엄벌, 최대치의 행정제재 등 최대한의 사후조치를 내각에 지시했다”며 “혼자 잘 살면 뭔 재민겨? 같이 삽시다”라고 썼다.)

As medical product supply instability grew due to the aftermath of the Middle East war, the government issued a "notice on banning hoarding of syringes and needles" on the 14th and began crackdowns on syringe distributors. According to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, this year's daily syringe production is 4.6 million units, a 28% increase from last year's daily average of 3.6 million. The ministry conducted special inspections targeting companies with low sales relative to inventory, excessive stockpiles, biased supply to specific clients, or high-priced syringe sales. (정부는 중동전쟁의 여파로 의료제품 수급 불안이 커지자, 지난 14일 ‘주사기 및 주사침 매점매석행위 금지 등에 관한 고시’를 발령하고 주사기 판매업체 단속을 시행하고 있다. 식약처에 따르면 올해 주사기 일일 생산량은 460만 개로 지난해 일평균 생산량인 360만 개 보다 약 28% 증가했다. 이에 식약처는 주사기 입고량 대비 판매량이 적거나 과도한 재고를 보유한 업체, 특정 거래처에 편중 공급하거나 높은 가격으로 주사기를 판매한 업체 등을 대상으로 특별 단속을 실시했다.)

The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety is also operating a "Report Center for Hoarding of Syringes and Needles" on its website. Reported companies are subject to checks for legal violations and potential prosecution. The ministry stated, "We will continue to conduct crackdowns by closely analyzing daily reports on production, sales (including buyers), and inventory data from manufacturers and distributors, as well as distribution channels between buyers." (식약처는 누리집을 통해 ‘주사기 및 주사침 매점매석행위 신고센터’도 운영 중이다. 신고된 업체에 대해선 법 위반 여부에 대한 점검, 고발 등의 조처를 한다. 식약처는 “제조업체와 판매업체로부터 매일 보고받고 있는 생산량, 판매량(판매처), 재고량 자료 및 판매처 간 유통 경로 등을 면밀히 분석해 지속해서 단속을 시행할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

By Son Go-woon, Reporter songon11@hani.co.kr (손고운 기자 songon11@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon keeps demanding stance on LTPA... Jung Won-oh "Compete with policies" (오세훈 연일 ‘장특공’ 입장 요구에…정원오 “정책 승부하라”)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon on the 25th once again urged Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for Seoul mayor, to clarify his position on the "abolition of the Long-Term Holding Special Deduction (LTPA)." This comes after the first opinion poll following the confirmation of the ruling and opposition Seoul mayoral candidates for the June 3 local elections showed Jung leading Oh, the People Power Party candidate, by over 10 percentage points. It appears to be a strategy to win over "Seoul real estate" sentiment. (오세훈 서울시장이 25일 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보를 향해 ‘장기보유특별공제(장특공) 폐지 방침’에 대한 입장을 밝히라고 재차 촉구했다. 6·3 지방선거 여야 서울시장 후보 확정 뒤 첫 여론조사에서 정 후보 지지율이 오세훈 국민의힘 후보를 10%포인트(p) 넘게 앞선 것으로 나타난 가운데 ‘서울 부동산’ 민심을 잡으려는 전략으로 보인다.)

On Facebook that day, Mayor Oh said, "What is Candidate Jung's precise position on the president's abolition of the LTPA?" adding, "As a candidate for Seoul mayor who claims to be responsible for the lives of 10 million Seoul citizens, this is a question that must be answered." He continued, "President Lee has once again made his will to abolish the LTPA clear through social media (SNS), targeting non-resident single-home owners as people who have invested in housing for a long time, effectively branding them as speculators." (오 시장은 이날 페이스북에 “대통령의 장특공 폐지에 대한 정 후보의 정확한 입장은 무엇이냐”며 “천만 서울시민의 삶을 책임지겠다는 서울시장 후보라면 반드시 대답해야 할 질문”이라고 말했다. 이어 “이 대통령이 사회관계망서비스(SNS)를 통해 또다시 장특공 폐지 의지를 확실히 밝혔다”며 “비거주 1주택자를 겨냥해 주택에 오랫동안 투자한 사람들이라며 사실상 투기꾼으로 낙인찍었다”고 덧붙였다.)

The previous day, Mayor Oh appeared on TV Chosun's YouTube channel and said of Candidate Jung, "He is highly likely to become President Lee Jae-myung's yes-man," adding, "The abolition of the LTPA is an issue on which a Seoul mayoral candidate must state a clear position." (오 시장은 전날도 티비조선 유튜브에 출연해 정 후보를 향해 “이재명(대통령)의 예스맨이 될 가능성이 높다”며 “(장특공 폐지는) 서울시장 후보라면 분명한 입장을 밝혀야 할 사안”이라고 말했다.)

In response, Candidate Jung met with reporters at Namdaemun Market on the 25th and said, "I'm busy discussing the future and busy promoting my policies for Seoul citizens," adding, "Mayor Oh keeps saying negative things about me, but I hope he would compete with policies for the citizens." (이와 관련해 정 후보는 25일 남대문시장 현장에서 기자들과 만나 “미래를 논하기에도 바쁘고 서울시민을 위한 저의 정책을 알리기에도 바쁘다”며 “오 시장이 자꾸 저에 대해 부정적인 말을 하는데 시민을 위한 정책으로 승부했으면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, according to an opinion poll commissioned by CBS from the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) and released on the 24th (surveyed on the 22nd-23rd among 1,001 adults aged 18 and older in Seoul, using wireless ARS, with a response rate of 5.1% and a margin of error of ±3.1%p at a 95% confidence level), in a hypothetical Seoul mayoral election matchup, 45.6% of respondents supported Candidate Jung, while 35.4% supported Candidate Oh. The gap is 10.2 percentage points. (한편 시비에스(CBS)가 여론조사 업체 한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)에 의뢰해 24일 공개한 여론조사(22~23일, 서울 거주 18살 이상 1001명, 무선 ARS 조사, 응답률은 5.1% 표본오차 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%p)에 따르면, 서울시장 선거 가상 대결에서 정 후보를 지지한다는 응답자가 45.6%, 오 후보를 지지한다는 응답자는 35.4%였다. 격차는 10.2%포인트(p)다.)

Son Go-woon reporter songon11@hani.co.kr (손고운 기자 songon11@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Fast-tracked Public Institutions Act... A Turning Point for Reform After 19 Years (패스트트랙 탄 공운법…19년 만에 개정 전환점)
item.description:
<<>> The amendment to the Act on the Management of Public Institutions (Public Institutions Act) has entered the legislative fast track and moved to the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, the final step before a plenary session, bringing the bill closer to passage. If the amendment is finalized, the independence and status of the Public Institution Management Committee, which has been criticized as a rubber stamp or auxiliary decision-making body for the Ministry of Finance and Economy (formerly the Ministry of Strategy and Finance), are expected to be strengthened, leading to changes in the management and evaluation system of public institutions. Enhancing the quality of public services (such as electricity, gas, railways, pensions, and social insurance) through innovation in public institutions, including strengthening the representativeness of the committee, was one of the state tasks of the Lee Jae-myung administration. ()

The amendment to the Public Institutions Act, which moved to the Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 24th of last month, was proposed by independent lawmaker Kim Byung-kee in September last year as a ruling party bill when he served as the floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea. The core of the amendment is to elevate the status of the Public Institution Management Committee from an advisory body to a semi-independent administrative committee, in order to ease the uniform control of the Ministry of Finance and Economy over the 342 public institutions (including public corporations, quasi-governmental agencies, and other public institutions) as of April 2026. This follows the assessment that, while the Ministry of Finance and Economy previously maintained the committee as a formal decision-making body and held tight control over the budget, personnel, and management evaluations of public institutions, it failed to simultaneously enhance their autonomy and accountability. The amendment allows a civilian expert to serve as co-chair of the committee alongside the Minister of Finance and Economy, considering the characteristics and diversity of each public institution, and increases the number of committee members from 11 to 14. It also establishes a secretariat to align with the elevated status of the committee, which deliberates and votes on the designation, dissolution, evaluation, and overall policies of public institutions, and transfers the Ministry of Finance and Economy’s Public Policy Bureau to this secretariat. Enacted in 2007, the Public Institutions Act now stands at a significant turning point after 19 years, driven by persistent demands for revision from academia, labor, and civil society. <<> On the 24th, at the 2026 Spring Conference of the Korean Policy Studies Association held at the Korea Local Information Research & Development Institute in Sangam-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul, experts repeatedly emphasized the significance of the amendment to the Public Institutions Act and urged its prompt passage by the National Assembly. Lee Jong-wook, a professor at Seoul National University of Science and Technology, who served as moderator at a discussion titled “Where is the Public Institutions Act Heading?” held that afternoon, stated, “Public institutions must operate with vitality for the lives of the people to improve. In that sense, the amendment to the Public Institutions Act is important.” He added, “Since it has been designated as a fast-track item, it can be processed after a certain period, but it would be better if it passes through the National Assembly a bit earlier.” Currently designated as a fast-track item, the amendment was unable to reach a consensus between the ruling and opposition parties in the relevant standing committee, the National Assembly’s Finance and Economy Committee, and thus moved to the Legislation and Judiciary Committee after completing the 180-day fast-track review period in the standing committee. If the Legislation and Judiciary Committee fails to reach a conclusion within 90 days, the bill automatically proceeds to the plenary session. If not placed on the agenda within 60 days after that, it automatically appears on the agenda of the first plenary session held after 60 days for a vote. However, if the ruling and opposition parties narrow their differences and process the amendment earlier, the timeline for reorganizing and launching the Public Institution Management Committee could be advanced. <<> Particularly, labor groups are demanding that the amendment include a compensation committee under the Public Institution Management Committee to pre-deliberate on wages of public institution workers. Nam Tae-seop, senior vice-chairman of the Korea Electric Power Industry Labor Union Federation, who participated as a panelist in the discussion, emphasized, “The first gateway to public institution reform is to free the Public Institution Management Committee, which has been captured by bureaucracy, from that structure, and equip it with expertise, independence, and diversity so that public institutions can provide better services to the people. Considering the current government’s policy stance of a people-centered administration, a structure that reflects diverse opinions in the committee is necessary.” He added, “In particular, a compensation committee should be established within the Public Institution Management Committee to create a negotiation mechanism for determining wages of public institution workers.” La Young-jae, a professor at Konkuk University, who presented at the discussion, explained the significance of the amendment, stating, “This amendment to the Public Institutions Act is only the beginning of public institution reform,” adding, “The revision of the Public Institutions Act and the reform of the management system will contribute to national economic development and people’s livelihoods.” Song Ho-jin, Senior Reporter, The Hankyoreh Economy & Society Research Institute dmzsong@hani.co.kr ( 공공기관의 운영에 관한 법률(공운법) 개정안이 신속처리안건(패스트트랙)으로 지정된 뒤 국회 본회의 직전 문턱인 법제사법위원회로 넘어가면서 법안 처리가 가시권에 들어왔다. 개정안이 최종 처리되면 재정경제부(옛 기획재정부)의 거수기 또는 보조 의결기구라는 비판을 받았던 ‘공공기관운영위원회’(공운위) 독립성과 위상이 강화돼 공공기관 관리와 평가 체계의 변화가 예상된다. 공운위 대표성 강화를 포함한 공공기관 혁신을 통해 공공서비스(전기·가스·철도·연금·사회보험 등)의 질을 높이겠다는 구상은 이재명 정부의 국정과제 가운데 하나였다. )
